original_test_intent: Qualify five hundred full-width Gen1-to-Gen6 transitions on the intended GB-NV-PVP PCIe path, but only if the exact platform, firmware, endpoint, and qualification tool positively support that generation.
original_method: First prove end-to-end Gen6 capability without forcing unsupported controls and obtain the authoritative Speed Change 16 recipe; then for each cycle establish Gen1, request Gen6, record intermediate LTSSM/equalization and settled full-width Gen6 with error/health deltas, inhibit subsequent cycles at the first ambiguity, and use approved out-of-band recovery.
manual_activity: Platform/PCIe owner must certify Gen6 implementation and the vendor recipe; lab personnel isolate the SUT and own physical/console recovery from unsupported or unstable training.
required_inputs: Authoritative platform and vendor evidence that every PCIe path component and firmware supports Gen6 at required width
Pinned Gen6-capable LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 16 configuration
Gen1 entry, Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle timeout, transient, width, and error rules
500-count, abort, final-state, artifact-integrity, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: No execution or register forcing without positive Gen6 support evidence
Dedicated SUT with stable power/cooling and out-of-band console
Stop on unsupported-mode indication, wrong start, failed/late Gen6, reduced width, new AER, endpoint/GPU/host loss, reset, thermal/power anomaly, or evidence gap
agent_execution_scope: Validate explicit Gen6 capability, topology, tool, and criteria
Run only the owner-approved operation after the capability gate
Fail closed before the next cycle
Do not infer capability from names, force speed bits, accept Gen5/reduced width, clear evidence, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Certify Gen6 path and Speed Change 16 semantics
Approve 500-cycle high-generation stress and measurable acceptance
Review all results and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed tool family matches the source concept, but it assumes Gen6 feasibility and supplies neither the exact Speed Change 16 operation nor safeguards against unsupported-mode forcing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after documented Gen6 capability, use the pinned Speed Change 16 recipe with atomic Gen1 entry, Gen6 request/equalization, full-width settle, and error/health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LTSSM, 500 Gen1-to-Gen6 transitions, expected width/speed, no errors, no bundle, and 30/180-minute allocation remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Make support evidence an explicit prerequisite, then execute a fail-closed transaction ledger for the uniquely high-generation target.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the essential feasibility proof, complete channel identity, state/evidence contract, and safe failure recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Gen5 operation, a software-exposed but unsupported value, or one nominal Gen6 snapshot cannot prove five hundred genuine full-width Gen6 transitions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Forcing an unsupported speed may strand the endpoint or host, produce persistent AER/recovery loops, or create misleading downgraded results.

project_override_considerations: If the exact product revision does not implement Gen6 at the required width, record execution BLOCKED and preserve the testcase; do not change it to Gen5 or borrow evidence from another row.
expected_evidence: Positive Gen6 capability proof for every path component/firmware plus pinned tool/configuration
Complete topology/lane map and Gen1-to-Gen6 state/timing/error contract
Raw monotonic 1-500 transaction records with initial/intermediate/equalization/final states and timestamps
First-fault recovery or clean final state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Adds a mandatory Gen6 feasibility gate and rejects unsupported forcing or silent downgrade while retaining the full source target and repetition coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A tool option or testcase name does not prove the silicon, retimers, board channel, endpoint, and firmware implement Gen6. Attempting repeated transitions without that proof can cause a persistent training loop or downtrain that looks superficially active but never exercises the requested rate. Capability must be established before stress, then each cycle must independently record Gen1 entry, Gen6 equalization, full-width settle, and error deltas. If capability is absent, BLOCKED execution is the correct result; changing the generation would be coverage regression.
